calculation_handling.description: On a lot with a permitted maximum floor space index of 0.6, a detached house built before October 15, 1953 may be enlarged by a rear addition so long as the overall floor space index, including the addition, does not exceed 0.69.
calculation_handling.gaps: Applies only to a detached house erected before October 15, 1953 and only to a rear addition; the construction date of the existing house is not in our lot data.

units.disclosure: This lot may allow a rear addition to a pre-1953 detached house up to a total floor space index of 0.69 (instead of 0.6). We cannot confirm the house's construction date from our data, so this allowance is not applied automatically.

calculation_handling.description: A condition of the pre-1953 rear-addition allowance: every finished floor level in the addition must be no higher than the uppermost floor level of the existing building.
calculation_handling.gaps: Needs the floor levels of the existing building, which we do not hold.

units.disclosure: For the rear-addition allowance on a pre-1953 detached house, the addition's floors can be no higher than the top floor of the existing house. We cannot check this from our data.

calculation_handling.description: A condition of the pre-1953 rear-addition allowance: the addition may be no closer to the nearest side lot line than the existing side main wall of the building.
calculation_handling.gaps: Needs the as-built distance from the existing side main wall to the side lot line, which we do not hold.

units.disclosure: For the rear-addition allowance on a pre-1953 detached house, the addition cannot come closer to the side lot line than the existing house's side wall. We cannot measure the existing wall position from our data.

calculation_handling.description: A condition of the pre-1953 rear-addition allowance: any earlier addition to the house must be at least 5 years old.
calculation_handling.gaps: Needs the dates of any earlier additions, which we do not hold; an age limit has no expressible form.

units.disclosure: For the rear-addition allowance on a pre-1953 detached house, any earlier addition must be at least 5 years old. We cannot check addition dates from our data.

900.3.10(1406).explanation: RD exception 1406: on a lot whose permitted floor space index is 0.6, a detached house built before October 15, 1953 may get a rear addition up to a total floor space index of 0.69, if the addition's floors are no higher than the existing top floor, it comes no closer to the side lot line than the existing side wall, and any earlier addition is at least 5 years old. Raised platforms higher than the first floor may not extend into a required front or rear yard, and on lots 7.6 metres wide or narrower a vehicle entrance through the front wall is not allowed. Sections 12(2) 118 and 119 of former By-law 438-86 also apply.

900.3.10(1432).explanation: RD exception 1432: any addition above the first storey of an existing detached house must meet the By-law's minimum setbacks, and raised platforms higher than the first floor may not extend into a required front or rear yard. Sections 12(2) 118 and 119 of former By-law 438-86 also apply, and former site-specific by-laws govern 93 Dawlish Ave (585-86), 73 Glengowan Rd (533-80) and 5 Weybourne Cres (563-80).
